hook: Banjara Hills Road No.2 diverted for *steel flyover* works
hook_b: Banjara Hills Road No.2 diverted for *steel flyover* works
tldr: Traffic police have diverted traffic around Banjara Hills Road No.2 for H-CITI steel flyover construction between Jubilee Hills Check Post and NFCL.

beats.what: Congestion is expected between Srinagar 'T' Junction and NTR Bhavan; commuters to Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Madhapur and the Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge are told to use other routes.
beats.why: The steel flyover is part of the H-CITI project between Jubilee Hills Check Post and NFCL.
beats.care: Begumpet to Madhapur traffic is routed via Panjagutta Flyover 'Y' Junction, Taj Krishna, Road No. 1 and Zaheranagar.

effects.label: Jams Srinagar T to NTR Bhavan

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Srinagar Colony to NTR Bhavan or the Cable Bridge: go via Indiranagar Gadda, Venkatagiri and Jubilee Hills Road Nos. 10 and 36. Helpline: 9010203626.

cards.q: Will you change your route or timing this week?

qs: Will the detours via Road Nos. 10 and 36 move the jams into Jubilee Hills lanes?
When is the Check Post-NFCL steel flyover due to finish?

facts.t: Police flag *6.5 hours* a day of peak time to avoid: 8.30-11 am and 5-9 pm.

viz.verdict: Police advise commuters to skip these windows

watch: How long the Road No.2 diversions stay in place; the police notice gives no end date.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Traffic curbs in place near Banjara Hills as H-CITI steel flyover construction progresses

fact: Steel flyover works divert Banjara Hills Road No.2 traffic, avoid *8.30-11 am*
twist: Police name *four* separate detours, from Panjagutta 'Y' Junction to Jubilee Hills Road No. 36.
